Info

Defines ScaraTokenType enumeration representing lexical token categories for SCARA DSL.

class scarajectory.core.model.dsl.scara_token_type.ScaraTokenType(value, names=<not given>, *values, module=None, qualname=None, type=None, start=1, boundary=None)[source]¶

Bases: Enum

Enumeration of token types produced by SCARA DSL lexer.

It defines:

attributes:
KEYWORD - Command keyword token (e.g., MOVE_L, HOME).
IDENTIFIER - Generic identifier or parameter key name.
NUMBER - Integer or floating point number literal.
STRING - Quoted text literal.
EQUALS - Equals assignment symbol ‘=’.
COMMA - Delimiter comma symbol ‘,’.
LPAREN - Left parenthesis ‘(‘.
RPAREN - Right parenthesis ‘)’.
COMMENT - Line comment beginning with ‘#’ or ‘;’.
NEWLINE - End of line separator.
EOF - End of input stream.
methods:
None.
